subject: Re: Status: latency table doesn't transfer 1:1, accuracy does
body:
Team — decisions from the go/no-go prep.

We proceed to the Jul 24 readout recommending the edge-inference tier, on the strength of our own latency table — device-lab numbers only, with the paper's SD835 figures as historical reference.

The rating round ran the trimmed pairs-only protocol on the new UI; with about 1,900 rated pairs, human-perceived quality of the 85-90% sparse models is statistically indistinguishable from dense on our demo distribution, which closes the perceived-regression question.

Scope cuts final: no free-text feedback this round, and the EfficientNet variants move to Q4 — fully unstructured sparsity needs different kernels than the MobileNet path.

Paloma — package the annotation tool docs; other teams will want it. Readout deck reviews Wednesday.

Zofia
